description: One OpenAI embeddings call with two inputs, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so the two input strings are recorded on the span as gen_ai.input.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. These provider packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch and no vendor export URL; spans go through the harness tracer provider. gen_ai.prompt.N is not written. Prompt tokens 6 are copied from prompt_tokens, and cache_read.input_tokens is 0. The vectors are not span attributes.
